facts.fact: Wacker 在办公室把 Helga Q. FLYSPECK 介绍给 Andre B. KRAY。
facts.anchor: I want you to meet Helga Q. FLYSPECK. FLYSPECK, Andre B. KRAY.

facts.fact: KRAY 与一名身材丰满的金发女子握手，她身高约五英尺三英寸，年龄约五十九岁半。
facts.anchor: KRAY shook hands with a plump bottle blonde who stood just about five foot three and appeared to be right around fifty-nine and a half years old.

facts.fact: Wacker 说 FLYSPECK 认为需要新增五百名经理，每两名 GOOWIKI NOC 配一名。
facts.anchor: FLYSPECK thinks five hundred new managers, one for every two GOOWIKI NOCs, ought to take care of the problem.

facts.fact: Wacker 指示 FLYSPECK 迅速推进，尽快为 GOOWIKI 项目的这个新单位拨款。
facts.anchor: move ahead on this smartly and get funds allocated to this new element of the GOOWIKI program asap.

facts.fact: Wacker 还表示需要一间更大的会议室和更多金条。
facts.anchor: a bigger conference room and more gold bars.

facts.fact: FLYSPECK 去年夏天提交了加入 Plus Size Mafia 的材料，希望晚春前入会，赶上去 Fort Lauderdale 的假期旅行。
facts.anchor: FLYSPECK had submitted her paperwork the previous summer to join the Plus Size Mafia. She was hoping to be in by late spring, before her holiday trip to Fort Lauderdale.

facts.fact: KRAY 在 Sametime 上问 BUTTONFLY 是否有时间在 Starbucks 快速见面。
facts.anchor: Got time for a quick meeting at Starbucks?

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 说 FLYSPECK 过去的标准提案是新增七十五个岗位。
facts.anchor: Used to be her standard proposal was seventy-five new bodies.
